name: Student Portal Development — Full Territory Audit
summary: Initial map/audit of all live portals, legacy portals, active students, class recordings, transcripts, and related territory. 9 P1 CRITICAL, 6 P2 HIGH, 4 P3 MEDIUM findings.

P1_CRITICAL.title: Lam portal suite incomplete
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: lam-portal.html exists. NO lam-profile.html, lam-transcripts.html, lam-methodology.html, lam-career.html, lam-action-plan.html
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Student portal partially functional — no profile, transcripts, or career pages

P1_CRITICAL.title: Minh has no portal HTML
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: No minh-portal.html in public/. Only minh-profile.html, minh-methodology.html, minh-action-plan.html, minh-transcripts.html
P1_CRITICAL.impact: minh-private student cannot access portal via standard route

P1_CRITICAL.title: Quy portal suite incomplete
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: quy-portal.html, quy-profile.html, quy-methodology.html, quy-career.html, quy-transcripts.html exist. MISSING quy-action-plan.html, quy-gospel444.html

P1_CRITICAL.title: Quan/Quang portal suites incomplete
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: quan-portal.html, quan-profile.html, quan-methodology.html, quan-transcripts.html exist. MISSING quan-action-plan.html, quan-career.html. Same for Quang.
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Incomplete portal experience for Quan and Quang

P1_CRITICAL.title: Portal routing inconsistency
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: 4 students via /student/{id} (huong, mai-tram, quy, minh). 3 students via direct HTML (lam, quan, quang). Inconsistent pattern.
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Architecture drift — suggests incomplete migration or ad-hoc additions

P1_CRITICAL.title: Deactivated portals confusion
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: quan-portal.html and quang-portal.html exist in BOTH public/ (live, 66KB) AND public/deactivated/ (old, 52-54KB). minh-parent-portal.html only in deactivated.
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Canonical source unclear. Risk of serving stale content.

P1_CRITICAL.title: VAULT data gap — only Mai Tram has recordings
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: VAULT manifests: huong=[], lam=[], quan=[], quang=[], quy=[]. Only mai-tram-bluetech has 2 recordings (general + phonics, ~2.9MB each). 2026-04-17 consolidation report says 46 recordings found, 2 moved to vault, 44 unresolved.
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Voice archive mostly empty. 44 recordings from April 2026 still unresolved.

P1_CRITICAL.title: Active students missing from VAULT
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: NET-STUDENTS/README.md lists Timmy, Tracy, Dan as active students. No VAULT entries for them.
P1_CRITICAL.impact: No recording vault, no manifest, no student profile in VAULT system

P1_CRITICAL.title: STUDENT-PORTAL-DEV.md stale
P1_CRITICAL.evidence: Last updated 2026-05-30 (Run 25). 13+ days old. Does not reflect current portal state (missing lam, minh portal status, deactivated portals, etc).
P1_CRITICAL.impact: Operational context out of date. Risk of working from stale docs.

P2_HIGH.title: No class intel for 4 students
P2_HIGH.evidence: CLASS-INTEL has sessions for: Mai Tram (June 10, June 28), Huong (June 11), Class10 (June 29). NO intel for Quy, Lam, Quan, Quang, Minh.
P2_HIGH.impact: No transcript, vocab, methodology, or gameplan for majority of students

P2_HIGH.title: Oktava system isolated
P2_HIGH.evidence: oktava-login/ has separate index, classroom, employer portals. run143-raw-transcript.txt and transcript.txt present. NOT in student portal map. NOT in VAULT.
P2_HIGH.impact: Oktava class data disconnected from main student portal system

P2_HIGH.title: Parent portal orphaned
P2_HIGH.evidence: parent-quan-quang/index.html exists. No clear integration with main portal system or student map.
P2_HIGH.impact: Parent portal may be unreachable or unmaintained

P2_HIGH.title: Chat route mismatch
P2_HIGH.evidence: Portal map redirects to /magic-chat.html?studentId=... after onboarding. No chat.html in public/ (only magic-chat.html).
P2_HIGH.impact: Potential broken redirect if code references chat.html

P2_HIGH.title: Student ID naming drift
P2_HIGH.evidence: Portal map: lam-bluetech, mai-tram, minh-private. VAULT: lam-prospect, mai-tram-bluetech. README: lam-prospect, mai-tram-bluetech. STUDENT-PORTAL-DEV.md: lam-bluetech, mai-tram-bluetech.
P2_HIGH.impact: Identity inconsistency — same student referenced by multiple IDs

P2_HIGH.title: Deactivated portals lack documentation
P2_HIGH.evidence: No explanation in STUDENT-PORTAL-DEV.md or elsewhere for why minh-parent-portal.html, quan-portal.html, quang-portal.html were deactivated.
P2_HIGH.impact: Unknown if deactivation is intentional or accidental

P3_MEDIUM.title: No centralized student roster in code
P3_MEDIUM.evidence: Student data scattered across KV (student_profile_*), VAULT manifests, markdown files, and HTML. No single source of truth.
P3_MEDIUM.impact: Difficult to maintain consistency across systems

P3_MEDIUM.title: Audio clips outside repo
P3_MEDIUM.evidence: Minh's processed clips in D:\OB-1-CANONICAL\minh-clips\ not in repo. STUDENT-PORTAL-DEV.md references them but they're untracked.

P3_MEDIUM.title: Duplicate transcript files
P3_MEDIUM.evidence: mai-tram-transcripts.json exists in both OPERATIONS/ and OPERATIONS/OPERATIONS/ (typo directory).
P3_MEDIUM.impact: Duplicate data — unclear which is canonical

P3_MEDIUM.title: No portal navigation audit
P3_MEDIUM.evidence: Unclear if all portal pages are reachable from main navigation or if some are orphaned.
P3_MEDIUM.impact: Some portal pages may be unreachable by users

next_action: Remediation required: (1) Complete Lam portal suite (profile, transcripts, methodology, career, action-plan). (2) Create minh-portal.html or update portal map. (3) Add action-plan and career pages for Quan/Quang. (4) Resolve deactivated portal duplication. (5) Investigate 44 unresolved recordings from 2026-04-17 consolidation. (6) Update STUDENT-PORTAL-DEV.md. (7) Add class intel for missing students.
